lines.zh: 我从草叶尖上轻轻走过。
lines.en: I walk lightly along the tips of the grass.

lines.zh: 根须给我让出一条小路。
lines.en: The roots part to make me a small path.

lines.zh: 我踩过苔藓，没留下印。
lines.en: I cross the moss without leaving a print.

lines.zh: 花瓣一碰，我就滑过去。
lines.en: One touch of a petal and I slide on.

lines.zh: 林中空地是我的走廊。
lines.en: The forest clearing is my corridor.

lines.zh: 我走三尺，停一停，听听。
lines.en: Three paces, then I stop and listen.

lines.zh: 藤蔓下面比上面安全。
lines.en: Beneath the vines is safer than above.

lines.zh: 我跳着走，脚几乎不沾土。
lines.en: I hop along, feet barely touching soil.

lines.zh: 叶子替我拍手。
lines.en: The leaves clap for me as I pass.

lines.zh: 树影移了，我跟着移。
lines.en: The tree shadows shift, and I shift with them.

lines.zh: 一路都是落下来的孢子。
lines.en: Spores drift down the whole way.

lines.zh: 我躲进蕨叶里，只剩一点光。
lines.en: I slip into the ferns, leaving only a glimmer.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，像块苔石。
lines.en: I curl up small, like a mossy stone.

lines.zh: 泥土里有我的呼吸声。
lines.en: My breathing is buried in the soil.

lines.zh: 等风把落叶盖在我身上。
lines.en: I wait for the wind to cover me with leaves.

lines.zh: 我数虫子爬过根的次数。
lines.en: I count the bugs crawling over the root.

lines.zh: 这棵树记得我，我也记得它。
lines.en: This tree remembers me, and I remember it.

lines.zh: 太阳落在树冠上，落不到我。
lines.en: Sunlight lands on the canopy, never on me.

lines.zh: 我听着林子里所有的脚步。
lines.en: I listen to every footstep in the wood.

lines.zh: 地下的根比地上的枝热闹。
lines.en: The roots below are busier than the branches above.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一颗种子。
lines.en: I hold still, the way a seed does.

lines.zh: 露水从我肩上滚下去。
lines.en: Dew rolls off my shoulder and falls.

lines.zh: 你还没来，我先藏好。
lines.en: You have not come yet; I hide first.

lines.zh: 蝴蝶停在我手上喘气。
lines.en: A butterfly rests on my hand, catching its breath.

lines.zh: 林精不睡觉，只收拢自己。
lines.en: Sprites do not sleep; we simply fold up.

lines.zh: 这层落叶是我的被子。
lines.en: This layer of fallen leaves is my blanket.

lines.zh: 我把耳朵贴在地上听远处。
lines.en: I press an ear to the ground and listen far off.

lines.zh: 落叶盖住我，只露出一点衣角。
lines.en: Leaves cover me, all but a scrap of hem.

lines.zh: 你的靴子压断一根枯枝。
lines.en: Your boot crushes a dead twig underfoot.

lines.zh: 我从土里抬头看你。
lines.en: I lift my head from the soil to see you.

lines.zh: 你不像林子里的东西。
lines.en: You do not look like anything from this wood.

lines.zh: 你弯腰了，我可看见你了。
lines.en: You are bending down; now I see you.

lines.zh: 我看你的手指，不看脸。
lines.en: Your fingers interest me more than your face.

lines.zh: 你带着铁器的气味。
lines.en: You reek of worked iron.

lines.zh: 你再靠近，我就跳出来。
lines.en: One more step, and I will leap out.

lines.zh: 你的影子压到我的叶子上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls across my leaf.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边看着你，别踩。
lines.en: I am at your feet, watching; do not step.

lines.zh: 你带了斧头，我看见了。
lines.en: You brought an axe; I noticed.

lines.zh: 我在树皮后面，你在外面。
lines.en: I am behind the bark, and you are out there.

lines.zh: 别找，我本来就在这。
lines.en: Stop searching; I was here all along.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸让草叶动了。
lines.en: Your breath is moving the grass blades.

lines.zh: 看清了，你是来砍树的。
lines.en: Now I see: you came to cut trees.

lines.zh: 你打掉我半条命，就一下。
lines.en: One blow took half my life.

lines.zh: 我只有五点，你别再打了。
lines.en: I have only five; please stop hitting.

lines.zh: 我的光暗下去了一点。
lines.en: My glow has dimmed a little.

lines.zh: 疼得我缩回叶子里。
lines.en: The pain folds me back into the leaves.

lines.zh: 你踩到我了，不是故意的吧？
lines.en: You stepped on me, not on purpose, surely?

lines.zh: 我的叶子掉了两片。
lines.en: Two of my leaves have come off.

lines.zh: 这仇我记在树皮上。
lines.en: I carve this grudge into the bark.

lines.zh: 土是软的，我还是疼。
lines.en: The soil is soft, and it still hurts.

lines.zh: 我的魔法散了一地。
lines.en: My magic scatters across the ground.

lines.zh: 别告诉别的林精。
lines.en: Do not tell the other sprites about this.

lines.zh: 你手上的是花还是光？
lines.en: Is that a flower in your hand, or light?

lines.zh: 甜味飘过来，我头就探出来。
lines.en: Something sweet drifts over, and my head comes out.

lines.zh: 花粉落了一地，我忍不住。
lines.en: Pollen scattered everywhere; I cannot help myself.

lines.zh: 我不吃，只是想靠近一点。
lines.en: I do not eat it; I only want to come closer.

lines.zh: 那是蘑菇吗，颜色不对劲。
lines.en: Is that a mushroom? The color is wrong.

lines.zh: 你摇了摇，孢子飞起来。
lines.en: You shake it, and spores float up.

lines.zh: 我的叶子都朝你那边长。
lines.en: All my leaves are leaning toward you.

lines.zh: 就摸一下，我不拿走。
lines.en: Just one touch; I will not take it.

lines.zh: 这气味叫我浑身发痒。
lines.en: That scent makes my whole body itch.

lines.zh: 别抖太快，我跟不上。
lines.en: Do not shake it so fast; I cannot keep up.

lines.zh: 你撞飞了我，我在空中转。
lines.en: You knock me flying, and I spin in the air.

lines.zh: 我一碰就倒，别用力。
lines.en: One brush topples me; do not push hard.

lines.zh: 草被我压弯了，对不起。
lines.en: I bent the grass; forgive me.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖硬得像树桩。
lines.en: Your knee is as hard as a tree stump.

lines.zh: 我被撞回土里，缩成一团。
lines.en: I am knocked back into the soil and curl up.

lines.zh: 我只有两颗半的心，轻撞就碎。
lines.en: I have only two and a half hearts to lose.

lines.zh: 你的脚跟落地，我就滚了。
lines.en: Your heel lands, and away I roll.

lines.zh: 别推，我的翅膀会皱。
lines.en: Do not shove; my wings crease easily.

lines.zh: 我躲到叶子后面，你才停。
lines.en: I hide behind a leaf before you stop.

lines.zh: 这一撞让整片草都在颤。
lines.en: That bump sets the whole patch of grass shaking.

lines.zh: 另一只林精在林子里应我。
lines.en: Another sprite answers me somewhere in the wood.

lines.zh: 我们碰一碰额头就算成。
lines.en: We touch foreheads, and that is the whole vow.

lines.zh: 它藏在老橡树的根部。
lines.en: My mate hides at the roots of the old oak.

lines.zh: 我们分吃同一滴露水。
lines.en: We share a single drop of dew.

lines.zh: 两只一起跳，叶子会响。
lines.en: When we hop together, the leaves ring.

lines.zh: 它比我更怕人，先躲了。
lines.en: It fears people more than I do, and hid first.

lines.zh: 我们隔着树根互相看。
lines.en: We look at each other across the roots.

lines.zh: 它给我一片最软的叶子。
lines.en: It brings me the softest leaf it could find.

lines.zh: 同林的两只，脚尖对脚尖。
lines.en: Two of one wood, toe to toe.

lines.zh: 风吹过来，我们一起低头。
lines.en: The wind comes, and we bow together.

lines.zh: 地上一片花瓣，我不捡。
lines.en: A petal lies there; I do not pick it up.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，让根去收吧。
lines.en: Let the roots take whatever you dropped.

lines.zh: 我不藏东西，只藏在叶里。
lines.en: I hoard nothing; I only hide in leaves.

lines.zh: 那块碎铁硌得地面疼。
lines.en: That scrap of iron hurts the ground.

lines.zh: 我的手里只拿露水。
lines.en: The only thing I hold is dew.

lines.zh: 东西留在原地更自然。
lines.en: Things are better left where they fall.

lines.zh: 你的剑太重，我搬不动。
lines.en: Your sword is too heavy for me to lift.

lines.zh: 我不收礼物，也不收债。
lines.en: I collect no gifts and no debts.

lines.zh: 土里的东西归土。
lines.en: What is in the soil belongs to the soil.

lines.zh: 捡起来会毁了那片苔。
lines.en: Picking it up would ruin that patch of moss.

lines.zh: 你的脚步落到第三下，动了。
lines.en: On your third step, I made my move.

lines.zh: 树根把震动传给我了。
lines.en: The roots passed your tremor on to me.

lines.zh: 我一听见铁器就知道是你。
lines.en: One clink of iron and I know it is you.

lines.zh: 我从土里抬头，对准你。
lines.en: I lift my head from the soil and aim.

lines.zh: 你踩到了一块松土。
lines.en: You stepped on a patch of loose soil.

lines.zh: 我等了很久，就为这一次。
lines.en: I waited a long time for this one moment.

lines.zh: 靠近的人，我总要看看。
lines.en: Whoever comes close, I must have a look.

lines.zh: 我锁住你的影子，不锁你。
lines.en: I fix on your shadow, not on you.

lines.zh: 林子里没有别的动静了。
lines.en: There is no other movement in the wood.

lines.zh: 你在我的树旁边停下来了。
lines.en: You have stopped beside my tree.

lines.zh: 孢子先动，然后是我。
lines.en: First the spores stir, then I do.

lines.zh: 我听见你腰间的布袋响。
lines.en: I hear the pouch at your belt rustle.

lines.zh: 你挪一步，我挪半寸。
lines.en: You shuffle a step; I creep half an inch.

lines.zh: 我贴着树皮跟着你转。
lines.en: I keep to the bark and circle with you.

lines.zh: 别以为看不见就没有我。
lines.en: Do not think I am gone just because you cannot see me.

lines.zh: 我总贴着你的余光。
lines.en: I keep just inside your peripheral vision.

lines.zh: 你转头，我就换个位置。
lines.en: You turn your head, and I move again.

lines.zh: 根须告诉我你在哪。
lines.en: The roots tell me exactly where you are.

lines.zh: 我顺着藤蔓慢慢靠近。
lines.en: I creep closer along the vines.

lines.zh: 你的影子越来越长，我等它。
lines.en: Your shadow grows longer; I wait for it.

lines.zh: 我不追，我只是不离开。
lines.en: I do not chase; I simply do not leave.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，草就弯到哪。
lines.en: Where you walk, the grass bends.

lines.zh: 我把气息收到几乎没有。
lines.en: I draw my breath down until it vanishes.

lines.zh: 树冠挡住光，我正好跟着。
lines.en: The canopy blocks the light, and I follow it.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我就跳。
lines.en: A little closer, and I jump.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，只够着你的鞋。
lines.en: I lunge and only reach your shoe.

lines.zh: 我的爪子比针尖大不了多少。
lines.en: My claws are barely bigger than needles.

lines.zh: 这一下不疼，但你会记住。
lines.en: This does not hurt, but you will remember it.

lines.zh: 我从草里跳出来抓你脚踝。
lines.en: I leap from the grass at your ankle.

lines.zh: 打中就跑，这是我的打法。
lines.en: Hit and run, that is how I fight.

lines.zh: 五点的生命，我打得很省。
lines.en: With five health, I fight sparingly.

lines.zh: 你后退，我就不追了。
lines.en: If you back off, I will not follow.

lines.zh: 我的魔法只有一点点。
lines.en: I have only a little magic to spend.

lines.zh: 别抓我，我经不起一下。
lines.en: Do not grab me; I cannot take a hit.

lines.zh: 你袖口被我划开一线。
lines.en: I opened a thin line in your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我从土里冒出来，先露头。
lines.en: I come up out of the soil head first.

lines.zh: 老树根旁多了一点绿光。
lines.en: A small green glow appears by the old root.

lines.zh: 落叶翻开，我就在下面。
lines.en: The leaf litter turns over, and there I am.

lines.zh: 我一出现，虫子都不叫了。
lines.en: The moment I appear, the insects go quiet.

lines.zh: 这片林子本来就有我。
lines.en: This wood always had me in it.

lines.zh: 孢子落地的地方会长出我。
lines.en: Where spores land, I grow out of the ground.

lines.zh: 我从蕨叶的缝隙里挤出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out through a gap in the ferns.

lines.zh: 天刚暗，我就醒过来了。
lines.en: Just as it darkens, I wake up.

lines.zh: 树影一合，我就出现了。
lines.en: When the tree shadows close, I appear.

lines.zh: 土松了一下，就是我。
lines.en: The soil loosens once, and that is me.

lines.zh: 我不打招呼，我直接跳出来。
lines.en: I do not announce myself; I simply jump out.

lines.zh: 又一根老树记得我的名字。
lines.en: Another old tree remembers my name.

lines.zh: 我躲了很久，现在出来了。
lines.en: I hid a long time, and now I am out.

lines.zh: 林子里掉下一片叶子，我来了。
lines.en: A leaf falls in the wood, and I arrive.

lines.zh: 火一靠近，我的叶子卷起来。
lines.en: Fire comes near, and my leaves curl.

lines.zh: 我从一片叶子上掉下去。
lines.en: I drop from a single leaf.

lines.zh: 水淹过根，我的光灭了。
lines.en: Water covers the roots, and my glow goes out.

lines.zh: 爆炸的气浪把我掀进灌木。
lines.en: The blast wave throws me into the shrubs.

lines.zh: 一箭穿过叶缝，扎在我肩上。
lines.en: An arrow slips between leaves and pins my shoulder.

lines.zh: 别人的魔法压得我抬不起头。
lines.en: Another's magic presses my head down.

lines.zh: 没有露水，我一天天变小。
lines.en: Without dew, I grow smaller each day.

lines.zh: 雷劈中树干，我跟着亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the trunk, and I light up too.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有土，我无处藏。
lines.en: No soil in the void, nowhere to hide.
